Debug.Name: Enable Debug Logging
Debug.Hint: Turns on additional Marvel Multiverse debug logging for diagnostics.

RulesAuditDebugging.Name: Enable Rules Audit Debugging
RulesAuditDebugging.Hint: Exposes GM-only rules audit inspector helpers on game.marvelMultiverse.rulesAudit.

ShowRuleSourceReferences.Name: Show Rule Source References
ShowRuleSourceReferences.Hint: Displays source-reference details when available in audit/debug outputs.

WarnOnUnverifiedAutomation.Name: Warn on Unverified Automation
WarnOnUnverifiedAutomation.Hint: Shows warnings when automation behavior is not yet verified against official rules sources.

StrictValidationMode.Name: Strict Validation Mode
StrictValidationMode.Hint: Applies stricter validation checks for diagnostics without changing world data automatically.

GuidedResolutionEnabled.Name: Enable Guided Resolution
GuidedResolutionEnabled.Hint: Enables the Configure -> Roll -> Resolve -> Apply guided workflow dialog before rolling actions.

AutoApplyDamageOnResolve.Name: Auto-Apply Damage on Resolve
AutoApplyDamageOnResolve.Hint: When enabled (default), resolving an attack action automatically applies its damage. Disable to require an explicit Apply Damage button click.

AutoApplyDamageOnHit.Name: Auto-Apply Damage on Hit (requires socketlib)
AutoApplyDamageOnHit.Hint: When enabled, damage is applied automatically the moment an attack hits, even across clients (via the socketlib module) or before anyone opens the chat card. Off by default. Without socketlib installed/active, this only works for attacks made while a GM is logged in.

EnableOpposedCheckAutomation.Name: Enable Opposed Check Automation (unverified)
EnableOpposedCheckAutomation.Hint: Adds an opposed-check mode to the check-resolution dialog: compares a roll's total directly against a manually entered opponent total (higher wins, a lone Fantastic wins outright, ties are ties). This is a house rule, not a confirmed official ruling - off by default.

EnableTurnBasedTriggers.Name: Enable Turn-Based Power Triggers (unverified)
EnableTurnBasedTriggers.Hint: Lets power events fire on start/end-of-turn triggers for the acting combatant and any actor they targeted. Whose-turn-triggers-whom has no confirmed official procedure - off by default.

EnableExperimentalPowerOutcomes.Name: Enable Experimental Power Outcomes (unverified)
EnableExperimentalPowerOutcomes.Hint: Lets power events automatically apply damage/healing/resource-change, forced movement, and resize outcomes. These outcome types have no confirmed official ruling - off by default.

EnableSequencerEffects.Name: Enable Sequencer/JB2A Visual Effects
EnableSequencerEffects.Hint: Lets power events play a Sequencer animation (e.g. a JB2A asset) when they resolve. Purely cosmetic, requires the Sequencer module to be installed and active - off by default.

ActorSheetTheme.Name: Actor Sheet Theme
ActorSheetTheme.Hint: Select the visual style used by Character and NPC sheets on this client.
